006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.util.List;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IStringItem;
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
017
018/**
019 * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
020 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-default-language">fn:default-language</a>
021 * function.
022 * <p>
023 * This function returns the default language from the static context. If no
024 * default language has been configured, "en" (English) is returned as the
025 * default value per the XPath 3.1 specification.
026 */
027public final class FnDefaultLanguage {
028  private static final String NAME = "default-language";
029  @NonNull
030  static final IFunction SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
031      .name(NAME)
032      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
033      .deterministic()
034      .contextDependent()
035      .focusIndependent()
036      .returnType(IStringItem.type())
037      .returnOne()
038      .functionHandler(FnDefaultLanguage::execute)
039      .build();
040
041  private FnDefaultLanguage() {
042    // disable construction
043  }
044
045  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
046  @NonNull
047  private static ISequence<IStringItem> execute(@NonNull IFunction function,
048      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
049      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
050      IItem focus) {
051    return ISequence.of(fnDefaultLanguage(dynamicContext));
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * Implements <a href=
056   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-default-language">fn:default-language</a>.
057   * <p>
058   * Returns the default language from the static context. The default language is
059   * used by functions like fn:lang() when processing language-sensitive
060   * operations.
061   *
062   * @param dynamicContext
063   *          the dynamic evaluation context
064   * @return the default language code as a string
065   */
066  @NonNull
067  public static IStringItem fnDefaultLanguage(@NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
068    String language = dynamicContext.getStaticContext().getDefaultLanguage();
069    return IStringItem.valueOf(language);
070  }
071}
